description: React component for a camera view with overlay and capture/upload functionality, used in a wrist fitting application.

methods.name: CameraView({ onCapture, onUploadSelected, onToggleGallery })
methods.description: React functional component providing camera interface with overlay, capture, and upload controls.

methods.name: handleCapture
methods.description: Handles image capture from the video stream, stops the camera, and invokes the onCapture callback.

methods.name: handleUploadClick
methods.description: Triggers the file input dialog for image upload.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file selection, reads the image as Data URL, and invokes the onUploadSelected callback.
